title: Log in to the administrative workspace
description: A family user can sign in with institutional credentials and reach the authenticated administrative workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated administrative workspace is displayed
Verify access to administrative content is available

title: Explore the landing page and submit an enrollment inquiry

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation item for the institution overview section
Click the navigation item for the education levels section
Click the navigation item for the enrollment section
Fill in the parent or guardian name field with Ana Pérez
Fill in the contact email field with ana.perez@example.com
Fill in the inquiry message field with I would like information about enrollment for next term.
Submit the inquiry form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the enrollment inquiry form is no longer in its initial state
